subject: Re: Amendment request — fee corridor & capacity add (order form)
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@olivehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@olivehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Amendment request — add capacity + fee corridor (Order Form)

Rafael,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Procurement and our finance lead reviewed the current order form and we need an amendment to: 1) add a 25% capacity top-up pool for burst into Q3; 2) introduce a temporary fee corridor for market-indexed pricing on tokens for 6 months; and 3) clarify SOW acceptance criteria for the new integration work.

Can you send a proposed change order we can review with our legal and procurement? We prefer minimal changes to the MSA but understand the order form may need exhibits updated.

Attachments: none in this initial note — procurement will share PO details once we align.

Best,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager, Olive Health
Office: (415) 555-0199

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Amendment request — add capacity + fee corridor (Order Form)

Thanks, Marta — we can do this. Drafting notes below so legal can triage quickly: 

- Capacity top-up: propose Exhibit A, line item "Burst Pool (25% of baseline)" with monthly cap and prorated invoicing for partial months.
- Fee corridor: six-month temporary pricing corridor tied to a token index; recommend a floor/ceiling band (±8%) and a monthly reconciliation statement.
- SOW acceptance: add a short Acceptance Criteria table and a 10-business-day acceptance window with automated fallback to "deemed accepted" if no rejection with specifics.

I'll attach an initial redline of the order form and a clean Amendment Sched A for your review. Looping in Laura for legal alignment and Connor for procurement/ops impact.

Attachments: OliveHealth_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx; Amendment_SchedA_clean.pdf

Next steps: Laura/legal to confirm MSA cross-references and any signature blocks we should include. Marta — if you can share the PO number and target signing date, we will align timing and DocuSign setup.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Amendment request — add capacity + fee corridor (Order Form)

Marta / Rafael,

I reviewed the redline Rafael shared. High-level comments for Olive Health legal: 

1) MSA cross-reference: specify where the Amendment will sit (MSA Exhibit hierarchy). We prefer the amendment to explicitly state it amends the Order Form and Exhibit A only — not MSA core terms.
2) Fee corridor mechanics: clarify the index source (we propose using the Redwood token-price index published monthly) and dispute resolution for reconciliation amounts.
3) Proration language: use calendar-day proration for the initial partial-month top-up billing.
4) Acceptance & rollback: acceptance as proposed is OK, but add an operational rollback clause (30-day notice) if integration causes SLA regression.

I will prepare tracked-change comments on the attached OrderForm redline and a short legal memo. Kimberly, can you advise on whether the fee corridor requires a different invoicing SOW (Finance) or can remain in Order Form?

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Amendment request — add capacity + fee corridor (Order Form)

Quick notes from Finance/legal ops: 

- Fee corridor: Finance prefers consolidation into the order form invoice rather than a separate SOW; we'll add a reconciliation line item ("Monthly Corridor Adjustment") and require line-item detail exported in CSV for audit.
- Tax and compliance: ensure the fee corridor reconciliation is clearly labeled for tax reporting; Olive Health to confirm tax jurisdiction for cross-border implications.
- DocuSign signature flow: we recommend two-signatory flow (Olive procurement + Olive legal) then Redwood counter-signature. Connor, please confirm whether we want the standard Redwood signature block or an accelerated exec block.

I'll attach a short spreadsheet with an example monthly reconciliation for a $150k baseline to show how corridor adjustments flow through billing.

Attachments: pricing-exhibit-tracking.xlsx

Kimberly Park
Director, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@olivehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Olive Health Legal <legal@olivehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 14:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Amendment request — add capacity + fee corridor (Order Form)

Thanks all. Olive Health is generally comfortable with the approach. A couple of asks from our side: 

- We prefer percentage bands be expressed in absolute $ caps as well for easier monthly reconciliation.
- PO 557812 will be issued once final schedule and fees are agreed; target signing date is 2026-06-10.
- Please include a short implementation milestone appendix tied to the SOW acceptance so our PMOs can schedule integration windows.

Can Redwood push a DocuSign envelope for signature-ready documents by the end of day 2026-06-04 so internal routing on our side can run ahead of the 6/10 target?

Procurement Team
Olive Health

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@olivehealth.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Amendment request — add capacity + fee corridor (Order Form)

Appreciate the clarity — we'll action items below and plan to push a signature-ready DocuSign envelope by close of business 2026-06-04: 

Action items (Redwood):
- Laura: finalize tracked changes and confirm explicit MSA/Order Form cross-reference (due 06-03).
- Kimberly: finalize invoicing line and example CSV layout (due 06-03).
- Connor: confirm Redwood signature block and whether we use accelerated exec routing (due 06-03).
- Rafael: produce signature-ready PDF + DocuSign envelope and share link (target 06-04 EOD).

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
